model:
rachana: 1
sutra: path-book
version: 1
description: 
match: { kind: path-book, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Compute demo · Book", id: "$.BOOK_ID", with: "$.NAME" }
strip:
  - { label: "Desk", bind: "$.DESK" }
  - { label: "Strips", bind: "$.STRIP_COUNT" }
panels:
  - id: py-sum
    kind: metric
    title: "Sum of the paths · Python engine"
    key: "F2"
    value: "$src.SUM"
    label: "Sum over 250 days"
    fmt: "amount2"
    caption: "worst day ${fmt($src.WORST, 'amount2')} · path-sum-python"
  - id: py-path
    kind: line
    title: "Book path · Python engine"
    rows: "$src.TABLES.total"
    x: "DAY"
    y: "PNL"
    fmt: "amount2"
  - id: java-sum
    kind: metric
    title: "Sum of the paths · Java engine"
    key: "F3"
    area: right
    value: "$src.SUM"
    label: "Sum over 250 days"
    fmt: "amount2"
    caption: "worst day ${fmt($src.WORST, 'amount2')} · path-sum-java"
  - id: java-path
    kind: line
    title: "Book path · Java engine"
    area: right
    rows: "$src.TABLES.total"
    x: "DAY"
    y: "PNL"
    fmt: "amount2"
  - id: stamp
    kind: kv
    title: "How the Java answer was computed"
    area: right
    rows: "$src.STAMP"
  - id: book
    kind: kv
    title: "Book"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "must", from: "fragment" }
    rows: "$"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
keys: { F9: "raw" }
